text:
tanya: quick proposal — a tiny '48h closure' pattern for postmortem follow-ups. keep it one-line-per-action, explicit owner, ETA, verify-step.

ajay: yes please. reduces the long-tail and makes follow-ups scannable.

maria: i can own short-term mitigations (breaker + smoke test). will push a PR in 3h.

lucas: i'll run recurrence checks (90d) and surface any clusters; will flag for 72h RCA if needed.

incident-bot: Task created: INC-4601 - 48h closure checklist. Owners: maria, lucas, tanya. https://internal/tasks/INC-4601

tanya: comms cadence: internal updates only for 24h, 24h brief if mitigations incomplete, external comms only on SLA impact.

ajay: also tag severity of remediation (quick/med/long) and include verification command in runbook. tiny test helps oncall.

maria: PR: https://git/repo/patch4601 - breaker + `curl` smoke-check included. reviewers pinged.

lucas: alert hist posted: https://dash/alerts/DB-90d - weekly spikes noted; not identical to outage. annotated.

tanya: I'll add the one-line tracker to the incident doc: "owner | ETA | verify | notes" and close quick items after verification. reconvene 24h here.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h check-in for INC-4601.
